content.text:
No member project declares a class that extends or implements the `Controller` from `@nestjs/common`.

`Controller` there is a TypeScript symbol (`export type Controller = object;` plus the decorator function `Controller()`) in `../nest/packages/common`. The only other projects that could reference it are the TypeScript ones (`../nest/packages/core`, `../nest/packages/microservices`), and neither has any class with `extends`/`implements Controller`. The remaining members are Go (`client_golang`, `prometheus`), PHP (`drupal`, `laravel-framework`, `symfony`), and Python (`flask`, `werkzeug`) — they contain their own unrelated "controller" concepts but cannot extend a NestJS TypeScript export.

Matching files: none.
